messages:
maria: Quick sync — thinking through saved queries & default scope in Console Analytics. Current ask: when a user saves a query from a route view, should the default visibility be Route-only, Team, or Org? tradeoffs below.
kevin: my vote: default to Route. Most saves are troubleshooting for a specific route. Org-level saved queries = noisy.
anjali: agree with Route default, but we need an explicit switch in the save modal: radio for (Route | Team | Org) + an optional description. UX should make it clear who sees it.
sara: telemetry note: org-level queries will show up in more dashboards; we need to annotate saved-query metadata with scope and creator id for audit & usage stats. Otherwise cost+noise spikes.
noah: technical constraints: Team/Org saves imply we need ACLs + fast lookup by team in the index. Index currently keyed by route_id. Adding scope means we need a secondary index: (scope, owner_team, created_at). Not hard but needs migration.
maria: rough product compromise: default Route; in modal show "Save to Route (recommended)". Also allow a checkbox "Make visible to Team" that expands advanced options. That keeps primary flow simple.
kevin: implementation plan: add scope enum to SavedQuery model, default=route. API: POST /api/saved_queries {name, query, scope, route_id?}. Need backfill script to set scope=route for existing route-scoped ones.
anjali: UX nit: when loading console views, saved queries list should show a small badge: R / T / O and owner initials. Click badge -> quick switch to filter. Also allow pinning pinned per-user.
sara: telemetry: emit events for save_created with fields {saved_query_id, scope, route_id?, team_id?, user_id}. We should also log apply_saved_query with latency buckets to see perf impact.
noah: infra: when scope=org we should rate-limit preview evals for non-admins; org-level queries can be expensive if people run at org scale. Default preview should sample.
maria: one more debate: persistence lifetime. Should we auto-expire org-level queries older than 2 years? or leave to admin cleanup?
kevin: prefer admin cleanup with an optional "auto-archive" policy per org. More flexible for enterprise customers.
anjali: frontend: sample save modal mockup incoming. I'll attach in follow-up.
console-bot: deploy-check: saved-queries-service tests passing on staging ✅ (build #7321)
sara: action items: 1) kevin: design API + migration PR 2) anjali: modal + badge mocks 3) noah: index & rate-limit plan 4) maria: write product doc w/ default behaviors + admin policies — due EOD Wed.
maria: thanks all — let's keep scope default to Route and make Team/Org explicit opt-in. :thumbsup:
